en.html:
Sorimachi"...Yes, sir. Yes. Had a look all round, more or less..."
Sorimachi"Nothing moving. Packing up in a hurry? No sign. Putting on extra guards? That also no sign. Neither coming nor going, just there they are."
Sorimachi"Yes... my calculation has come out a little wrong, you could say."
Sorimachi"Muramasa getting finished off, we can't count on that now... Ah, yes, yes. Bilkul. I know whose responsibility. Mine, mine..."
Sorimachi"...I'll manage something. Only this greed for a good view without getting my hands in—give that up, and there are moves left yet..."
Sorimachi"Heh, heh, heh. So don't you worry yourself..."
